title: Affine-flat sections give flat stalks
statement: For a scheme Y, module sheaf G, affine-local flatness IsFlatOver G (𝟙 Y), and point x : Y, the stalk G_x is flat over the stalk ring O_{Y,x}.

source.place: Lemma flat-stalks-flat, using Algebra Lemma colimit-flat and localization flatness

proof.text: Choose an affine open V containing x using Mathlib exists_isAffineOpen_mem_and_subset. Let A = O(V), S = O_x and M = G_x. Give M its A-action by restricting the canonical S-action along the germ homomorphism. Mathlib IsAffineOpen.isLocalization_stalk identifies S as a localization of A. Module.flat_iff_of_isLocalization reduces the conclusion to A-flatness of M.

Let N be the subtype of OpenNhds x consisting of affine opens contained in V, ordered by inclusion. It is nonempty (V itself). Every pair admits a smaller affine neighbourhood inside its intersection, so N is cofiltered. The inclusion J from its opposite into (OpenNhds x)^op is final: refine any neighbourhood intersected with V by an affine neighbourhood; parallel arrows are equal since the categories are thin. This is implemented with Functor.final_of_exists_of_isFiltered.

Construct the functor F : N^op -> ModuleCat A whose values are G(U), restricted along O(V) -> O(U), and whose maps are section restrictions. Linearity follows from PresheafOfModules.map_smul and composition of ring restrictions. Construct a cocone with point M using germ maps. PresheafOfModules.germ_smul and germ_res_apply verify linearity and naturality. After forgetting to abelian groups this is the stalk colimit cocone whiskered by final J; Final.isColimitWhiskerEquiv makes it a colimit, and isColimitOfReflects lifts this to ModuleCat A.

The IsFlatOver hypothesis applied to V and every U in N gives flatness of F(U). The identity scheme appLE equals the ring restriction, by Scheme.Hom.appLE and Scheme.Hom.id_app. Apply ModuleCat.filteredColimit_flat to F and transfer flatness from colimit F to the stalk cocone point using its unique colimit isomorphism and Module.Flat.of_linearEquiv. Together with step 1 this proves the original stalk flatness statement.

proof_origin.place: lemma-colimit-flat and lemma-flat-localization (2); affine neighbourhood and germ construction in the Lean proof by X2
